posts.title: Classic SEC: Football and Men's Basketball
posts.description: Today we have new rankings on college football (from CBS Sports) and men's basketball (from Ken Pom). By combining these rankings, we can see how the Classic SEC programs compare. For example, Georgia is number 1 in the football rankings and number 46 in the Ken Pom rankings, so their overall rating is 47 (1+46=47). Here's the whole list: Alabama: 25 (6+19=25) Florida: 28 (25+3=28) Tennessee: 31 (7+24=31) Georgia: 47 (1+46=47) Mississippi: 53 (26+27=53) Louisiana St: 61 (32+29=61) Auburn: 75 (35+40=75) Kentucky: 91 (28+63=91) Vanderbilt: 99 (94+5=99) Mississippi St: 126 (64+62=126) UK's rating on Ken Pom is so bad that the Cats would be in seventh place on the above table even if they were Number 1 in football.

posts.title: Fourth Sunday in November
posts.description: Week 11 of the NFL, with six teams on bye this week. Here are the noon Central games (home teams listed first): Buffalo (8-1) v. Miami (1-8) Chicago (7-2) v. New Orleans (3-6) Dallas (4-6) v. Tennessee (1-8) Detroit (7-2) v. Tampa Bay (3-6) Kansas City (7-2) v. Arizona (3-7) Philadelphia (2-7) v. Pittsburgh (6-3) Carolina (4-5) v. Baltimore (4-6) We haven't been paying much attention to the NFL -- we had the Month of MLB, and there's been lots of NCAA football and basketball action. But we're almost done with the International portion of the schedule, and Thanksgiving weekend is coming up. It's a cold, gray day in the DC area, and the Commanders don't play until tomorrow night. It's a good time to start catching up on the NFL.
